description: This file defines the JavaEvent interface, which indicates that a BaseEvent is produced by a Java-based service. It extends ObjectIPC and declares a multicast group constant for event messaging.

classes.name: JavaEvent
classes.description: An interface to signify that the BaseEvent is produced by a Java-based Service, providing a multicast group constant for event distribution.

methods.name: IC_EVENT_MULTICAST_GROUP
methods.description: A constant string defining the multicast group address used for sending and receiving Java events.
